The spdx/license-list-data v3.29.0 annotated tag targets 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, the NC-SA detail's data commit. The API records an unsigned tag.
The cited CC capture matches the claim's publisher digest. Its inline title, section 1(g) and canonical link identify the NC-SA Generic edition at 2.5.

challenge.method: Compared the Japan example in licenseText with the document selected by crossRef and seeAlso, and checked section 1(g) against BY-SA.
challenge.results: Both citations select the unported by-nc-sa/2.5 legal code. Section 1(g) includes Noncommercial, which distinguishes the inspected BY-SA text. The Japan example supplies no competing document identity.

limitations: The 3.29.0 finding concerns the named generated JSON and CC capture. Equivalence of ports, translations, other project files and downstream licensing are outside its scope.
